items.title: Multiply pre-recorded streams with Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink
items.summary: Validating a streaming pipeline beyond current peak takes production-scale test data. This post shows how the stream multiplier pattern on Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink turns a small pre-recorded sample into sustained, production-scale load while preserving the statistical properties of real traffic.
items.creator: Sivaprasad Mahamkali
categories: Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink
